title: SREV-075 WriteProcessMemory workaround output gate contract

target_write.description: Caller WriteProcessMemory target address and byte count

workaround_scope.description: Firefox or Thunderbird ntdll patch suppression branch

contracts: WriteProcessMemory lpNumberOfBytesWritten is optional and NULL must be ignored
non-NULL lpNumberOfBytesWritten is a caller-owned output slot
fake-success workaround may write nSize only after the output slot write is protected
bad output slots fail the wrapper with ERROR_NOACCESS rather than crashing
non-workaround calls must flow to the real __sys_WriteProcessMemory owner
